findings.title: An inherited_unit fact that enumerates many symbols in one sentence gets a citation set covering only some of them, so the rest have no path into the composed candidate even though they are equally SUPPORTED and equally named in the same verbatim sentence.
findings.detail: inherited_unit:077.list (SUPPORTED, verbatim, lines 470-487 of the upstream README, section 'Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript > Scope and Limitations') names, in one sentence: 'mesh boolean operations (Mesh.union(), Mesh.difference(), Mesh.intersect(), Mesh.doBoolean(), Mesh.optimize(), Mesh.isManifold()), Watermark.encodeWatermark()/Watermark.decodeWatermark(), path-based scene queries (Node.selectSingleObject()/Node.selectObjects()), Scene.render(), and the standalone FileSystem helpers (createZipFileSystem, readFile, writeFile, createLocalFileSystem, createDummyFileSystem)' as all throwing 'not implemented' errors. dispositions.json's own S4 record for this unit (VERIFIED_PRESERVE) cites exactly 7 fact_ids as its supporting evidence: public_symbol:mesh.union, public_symbol:mesh.difference, public_symbol:mesh.intersect, public_symbol:watermark.encodewatermark, public_symbol:watermark.decodewatermark, dependency:development.adm-zip, example:007 - omitting public_symbol:scene.render, public_symbol:node.selectsingleobject, public_symbol:node.selectobjects, public_symbol:mesh.doboolean, public_symbol:mesh.optimize, and public_symbol:mesh.ismanifold entirely, despite all being SUPPORTED facts equally available in the packet (confirmed directly against facts.json). content_units.json's scope_limitations section shows the resulting split: limitation:1 (Mesh.union/difference/intersect + Watermark encode/decode), limitation:6 (FileSystem, citing public_symbol:filesystem directly alongside inherited_unit:077.list even though public_symbol:filesystem is ALSO absent from the S4 disposition's own fact_ids) - proving S6 CAN pull an uncited-by-S4 public_symbol fact from the same inherited sentence into its own bullet when it chooses to, but did not do so for Scene.render/selectSingleObject/selectObjects, and never for Mesh.doBoolean/optimize/isManifold at all (not even raised by review). Independent review's finding F05 correctly identifies the omission of the three it names, citing the genuinely SUPPORTED public_symbol facts as its own evidence; scope_defect's fold stack correctly does not fold it (absence_defect finds no candidate text containing the three method names in the scope_limitations section slice, and none of the fold conditions in factuality_defect apply since none of the cited product facts is CONTRADICTED and none contains the quote's literal value) - this is a real, correctly-surviving finding, not a reviewer defect. The one repair attempt (b0e43fe2abafc344b9b794eb, label F05, request_sha256 69ebe76749371f67515ed39504a80dc9f6088158b529e3254d190ef9e8cbd2ad) recorded outcome 'repaired' but its only change was to revised_output.omitted (before '[]', after a short JSON fragment) rather than a revision to the scope_limitations unit's own text; repair/rounds.py's re-review re-raised F05 identically. Proposed, smallest first: the S4 reconciliation job (or a deterministic post-processing pass over its output) links every symbol name literally present in an inherited_unit's own SUPPORTED text to its matching public_symbol fact and includes all of them in that disposition's fact_ids, not only the ones its own sampling happened to name; or S6 section_authoring is given the full set of symbols an inherited_unit's own text names (via a structured extraction of the inherited text, not free citation) so a partial enumeration cannot silently drop members its own source already names.
findings.evidence: review.json finding F05 (fact_ids: [public_symbol:scene.render, public_symbol:node.selectsingleobject, public_symbol:node.selectobjects], absent: [Scene.render, Node.selectSingleObject, Node.selectObjects]); content_units.json's scope_limitations/limitation:1 and limitation:6 units; facts.json inherited_unit:077.list (SUPPORTED, full verbatim value quoted above) and the six omitted public_symbol facts (all SUPPORTED, confirmed present in facts.json); dispositions.json's inherited_unit:077.list record (VERIFIED_PRESERVE, fact_ids listed above); repairs.json attempt b0e43fe2abafc344b9b794eb; validation.json BC-10 (FAIL, REJECT_FACTUAL, causal_stage EXTRACTING).
